_note: Rebuild Phase 2: every KEEP or MOVE row of docs/rebuild/screen_inventory.md maps either to an endpoint and the test that covers it ({"endpoint": "GET /api/...", "test": "tests/api/x.py::test_y"}) or to the phone alone with its reason ({"client": "phone", "why": "..."}, for example a timer's sound or the screen's styling). scripts/rebuild_gate.py p2 counts the rows that have neither (inventory_unmapped). Filled as milestone 5 builds the endpoints.

H1.why: The phone app's own shell and styling; the Streamlit CSS is not ported.

H4.why: The phone's own router; an unknown route opens Today. The Streamlit rule stays in services/navigation.py for the Streamlit app.

H5.why: The phone's tab bar, drawn by the shell outside every screen, so a failing screen keeps it.

H7.why: The phone opens on its own date and sends it as X-Local-Date (rebuild rule 3); a picked past day is the phone's own screen state.

H11.why: A button on the phone's Today screen that opens Check-in; no data.

H18.why: Tapping a card opens its drill-down screen: the phone's navigation.

H19.why: Static images bundled with the phone app.

I1.why: The phone groups the Insights screens its own way (KEEP: regroup for the phone); the tabs are its navigation.

I2.why: Four fixed category cards with static images; each opens its screen.

I3.why: Opening a category's screen is the phone's navigation.

I4.why: Cardio is a fixed coming-soon card (the owner will add Cardio later).

I29.why: "What this produces" is fixed text on the empty screen.

I40.why: Skip and Back move the phone's step over the capture order; Pause leaves the screen, and the draft stays in the store (F13).

I73.why: The method caption is fixed text.

I79.why: The store caption is fixed text: Supabase holds all data.

I87.why: The sync's cadence is fixed text; its state comes with GET /api/status.

I114.why: The tightness and pain scale reference is fixed text; it moves into the phone's strings file (rebuild rule 9).

I116.why: The phone's shell draws the tab bar outside each screen, so a failing screen keeps it.

I117.why: A button on the phone's Today screen that opens Check-in; no data.

I118.why: The phone uses one palette (the Oura palette); styling is the phone's.

T1.why: The phone app's own styling; the Streamlit CSS is not ported.

T2.why: Sound and notification permission are the phone's own (Web Audio, the browser's prompt).

T7.why: The phone's tab bar and its Back to Today button.

T42.why: The before-you-start prompt is fixed text and a checkbox; the phone keeps the answer with its session (whether to check the watch before the save).

T48.why: A session lives on the phone until it is saved; leaving it or discarding it is the phone's own state.

T78.why: Back walks the phone's own history of positions over the session's steps; no rule is involved.

T81.why: The hold countdown, its ticks and its auto-press are the phone's timer; its ending comes with each step (steps[].ending).

T83.why: The rest countdown and its bell are the phone's timer; the rest's length comes with the exercise (rest_seconds).

T84.why: The activity timer is the phone's; its minutes come with the exercise, and its key is the phone's session, never a stale browser key (F17).

T85.why: The count-up stopwatch is the phone's; which exercise runs one comes with the session (timer: stopwatch).

T86.why: The 880 Hz countdown ticks are the phone's sound.

T87.why: Background notifications are the phone's (only while hidden and allowed).

T88.why: Keeping the screen awake is a new phone requirement (the Wake Lock API).

T89.why: The day-complete banner is fixed text shown when the walk ends.

T98.why: The congratulations line is fixed text shown after the save answers.

T103.why: The + menu shows only while the phone runs no session of its own (F18): the session is the phone's state.

T104.why: The phone runs one session at a time: an accessory session cannot start over a plan session in progress.
